Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting files using a flawed encryption scheme; encryption scheme flaw exploited to create a decrypter; file encryption requiring encrypted and unencrypted file pairs to derive decryption key
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with encrypted files by HydraCrypt and UmbreCrypt ransomware
Indicators of Compromise: Encrypted files with extensions targeted by HydraCrypt and UmbreCrypt
